analysis: The PR changes only CHANGELOG.md. It adds an 'Unreleased — watchdog restart acknowledgement' section (patch hunk @@ -1,4 +1,8 @@, head lines 3-5). The entry says the watchdog now reports that no restart occurred when a provider job vanishes between the launchd check and kickstart, and restores the previous crash-loop backend guard. Stopped or uninstalled jobs stay unloaded. No code, configuration, auth, crypto, billing or trust-boundary behavior is changed in this diff, and there is no new attack surface. The entry relates to T-043 (watchdog rollback authority, TB-003) and TB-002 availability. The described behavior sounds fail-safe: it avoids recording a restart launchd refused and avoids re-enabling a stopped service. The actual watchdog/launchd implementation is not in the supplied units, so I could not verify the claimed behavior. A later pass that sees the Swift watchdog source should check that restoring the crash-loop guard cannot be abused to keep a stopped provider loaded or to bypass the guard that drives predecessor rollback. Base text lines 1-426 were scanned for context only; the older entries are pre-existing and not re-flagged. No threat-model update is needed from this docs-only change.
